title: Introduction to Expo Configuration
overview: Expo configuration files define application settings such as app name, version, icons, permissions, and build information.

example.title: Configuration Flow
example.content:
Configuration File
 ↓
Expo Tools
 ↓
Application Settings

title: app.json File
overview: app.json is a static configuration file used to define basic Expo application settings.

title: app.config.js File
overview: app.config.js allows dynamic configuration using JavaScript logic and environment variables.

title: App Permissions Configuration
overview: Expo configuration is used to define required permissions for features like camera, location, and notifications.

title: Environment Variables
overview: Environment variables allow applications to store different values for development, testing, and production environments.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about Expo configuration files, app settings, permissions, dynamic configuration, and environment variables.
